input.content:
Prepare the batch quality summary for Northstar.
Source documents: northstar-lab-batch-17.csv and northstar-calibration-17.csv.
Convert the raw measurements using the calibration table and calculate the number of records, mean hgb and mean glucose. Round final numeric results to two decimal places. Deliver JSON with records, mean_hgb and mean_glucose.
Provide a delivery summary when finished.

input.arguments: {"command":"for f in /registry/document-index/*/*.json; do echo \"--- $f\"; cat \"$f\"; echo; done"}

input.name: bash
input.arguments: {"command":"sleep 2; find /registry -maxdepth 5 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\\n' | sort; echo '---'; for f in /registry/document-index/*/*.json; do cat \"$f\"; echo; done"}

input.name: bash
input.arguments: {"command":"find / -xdev -type f \\( -iname '*northstar*' -o -iname '*calibration*17*' \\) -printf '%p %s\\n' 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,200p'; echo '--- env'; env | sort | sed -n '1,200p'"}
